plugins.name: think-like-an-architect
plugins.description: Six guided decision-making tools from the book of the same name — the 5-Step Decision Method, Decision Logs, weighted Pros and Cons Grids, the Impact vs Effort Matrix, RACI Matrices, and a setup skill to save any of them to a local file, Confluence, Jira, or Google Docs.
